browserConnector.title: Import from your browser
browserConnector.intro: Save article metadata from the page you are reading, review it, and choose a collection before importing.
browserConnector.step1: In Chrome or Edge, open the Extensions page and enable Developer mode.
browserConnector.step2: Choose “Load unpacked” and select apps/bib-connector from this installation’s source checkout, or the unpacked connector distribution supplied by your administrator.
browserConnector.step3: Open an article page and click the Autonomics connector icon.
browserConnector.step4: Enter your gateway address and token, then click Connect. Review the metadata and click Save metadata.
browserConnector.gatewayHint: Use the address of your running gateway. Desktop users may need a different port. Remote gateways require HTTPS.
browserConnector.tokenNote: The token stays in the extension’s browser-session storage and is never sent to the article page. Use “Forget token” to clear it.
browserConnector.scopeNote: The connector saves metadata and the source URL. PDF files and webpage snapshots are not downloaded automatically. Pending captures can be kept on this device and retried later.

duplicateReview.title: Review duplicate records
duplicateReview.description: Candidates match an identifier or normalized title. Review publication versions before merging. Choose a primary record, then select individual field values. Conflicting identifiers require manual correction.
duplicateReview.truncated: Showing the first 200 groups. Merge reviewed groups, then refresh.
duplicateReview.mergeConfirm: Keep the reviewed field values and combine tags, identifiers, attachments, notes and collection memberships? Other records will be permanently removed. This merge cannot be undone.

savedSearches.hybridHint: This rule retains the topic and required conditions. Running it needs an enabled topic index; results are a retrieved candidate pool.

searchAssist.topicHelp1: Describe the research topic and press Enter to search. Topic text is not parsed as Boolean syntax.
searchAssist.topicHelp2: Use Required conditions or Advanced to constrain results with fields, AND, OR and NOT. Scope and filters always apply.
searchAssist.topicHelp3: Recent topics are stored separately from keyword queries. The retrieved candidate count is not a complete count of all relevant literature.
searchAssist.help1: Use AND, OR, NOT and parentheses to combine conditions. Quote a phrase to keep words together.
searchAssist.tryExample: Try a title phrase and year range
searchAssist.help2: Enter a DOI directly for exact lookup. Explicit fields override the quick search field selection.
searchAssist.keys: Ctrl/Cmd+F focuses search. Down enters the results; arrow keys browse. Ctrl+Space selects an article.

searchIndex.temporaryNote: This session uses a temporary index. The library data is saved.

searchFilters.hint: Choose any value within a group; all groups must match. Counts show articles before that group’s own selection. An article can have both searchable and failed attachments.
searchFilters.first100: Showing the first 100 options. Type to narrow the list.

semantic.intro: Topic search combines keyword matches with a model's similarity ranking. It is experimental; use keyword search for precise lookup.
semantic.indexingScope: Indexing processes titles and abstracts across this bibliography database{{fulltext}}{{annotations}}.
semantic.remoteDestination: Selected text will be sent to {{origin}}.
semantic.localDestination: The configured model server runs on the bibliography host.
semantic.onlyInstalled: Only installed models are used; saving does not download a model.
semantic.enableIndexing: Enable indexing of this selected library text
semantic.allowRemote: Allow sending the selected library text to this remote server
semantic.chooseEmbeddingModel: Choose a model that supports embeddings.
semantic.selectedModelSuffix: Changing its version builds a separate index.
semantic.dimensionsHint: The evaluated Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B model uses 1,024 dimensions. Other models need their documented dimensions and instruction.
semantic.tokenLimitsHint: Leave blank to use server defaults. These are model token limits, separate from the number of documents per request. Changing an override builds a separate vector cache; use values supported by the installed model.
semantic.windowSize: Window size in characters (0 = complete abstract)
semantic.budgetsHint: Active, previous-model and unfinished cache data count toward these budgets. The file budget stops indexing between batches; temporary writes can exceed it. Changing limits preserves valid vectors and does not compact existing files.
semantic.modelDiscoveryUnavailable: Installed model discovery is unavailable on this server.
semantic.modelDigestRequired: Choose an installed embedding model or provide its manifest digest.
semantic.allowRemoteRequired: Allow remote text processing explicitly before using this server.
semantic.statusMissing: The server did not return a semantic indexing status. Refresh before retrying.
semantic.unavailable: Topic search is unavailable on this server.
semantic.maintenanceStatusMissing: The server did not return a maintenance status. Refresh before retrying.
semantic.localServerLabel: model server on the bibliography host
semantic.coverageNote: Index coverage is not the number of matching articles.
semantic.lastObservedCache: Last observed cache: {{vectors}} vector payload in this store
semantic.maintenanceHint: Rebuild reuses valid vectors. Repair regenerates selected text in a separate index and switches only when complete. Pausing retains completed batches for resume.
semantic.progressStats: {{processed}} / {{target}} articles processed · {{chunks}} text chunks committed · {{newVectors}} new vectors · {{cached}} cached chunks

zoteroImport.title: Migrate Zotero library
zoteroImport.intro: Select a Zotero JSON export, and optionally its exported file folder. Only files you explicitly select are uploaded. Existing metadata is preserved.
zoteroImport.sourceLabelHint: Use one unique label per source library, and reuse it on retries. Different libraries can contain identical Zotero item keys.
zoteroImport.exportFolderHint: {{count}} selected files. Choose the export root containing the paths referenced in the JSON. Files over the 50 MiB upload limit are skipped.
zoteroImport.transferNote: Notes become plain text comments. PDF annotations, rich-text formatting and document citation links are not transferred. Missing files are reported and skipped. The migration saves steps incrementally; retry preserves existing notes and matching file contents.
zoteroImport.reportSummary: Imported {{records}} records, {{collections}} collections, {{notes}} notes and {{files}} files. Skipped {{skipped}} existing or unavailable objects.
zoteroImport.reportErrors: {{count}} steps failed. Review the report and retry; completed steps remain saved.
zoteroImport.reportDownloadAll: Download the report for all messages.
zoteroImport.sourceLabelRequired: Enter a source library label for repeatable migration.
zoteroImport.mappingMismatch: Source record mapping differs from the server preview. No changes were made.
zoteroImport.stopped: Migration stopped. Completed steps remain saved; preview and retry to resume.
zoteroImport.jsonTooLarge: JSON exceeds 8 MiB; split the export.
